screen.annulus_scan: 0.35 to 1.05 of each predefined circle radius, 8-pixel steps
screen.null: exact conditional longest circular LOOP-run probability, preserving n and LOOP count
screen.multiple_testing: Bonferroni within-circle annulus scan; 14-circle correction also reported

headline.f70like_gate: >=8 LOOP objects and contiguous LOOP run >=5

f67r_R.interpretation: closest ordinary control, but does not survive annulus correction and run is only 3

f68r.interpretation: low raw p reflects two adjacent loop-like letter shapes in a text-bearing annulus; not f70-like

f70v_partA.interpretation: single-setting three-object cluster; collapses under threshold/centre sensitivity and is embedded in illustrated/text material, not a replicated micro-register

decision.f70r1_status: unique among screened circular structures under the frozen morphology detector
decision.broad_circular_loop_motifs: occur elsewhere, but at different scale/context and do not reproduce the f70r1 categorical island
decision.functional_inference: weakened: no internal replication means the register should not yet be treated as a general Voynich notation system
decision.next: treat f70r1 as a one-off local construction unless a new folio or external exact structural match reproduces the full signature
